subject: Joint Azure + GCP marketplace co-sell — Sandglass / Atlas scheduling
messages:
From: Carolyn Lee <carolyn@sandglass.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Tran <mark@atlas-sys.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro — Sandglass x Redwood joint marketplace showcase (Azure + GCP)

Hi Grace,

Hope you're well — Sandglass is lining up a co-sell showcase with Atlas (our SI) to highlight the multi-cloud listing path: Azure Marketplace + GCP marketplace channels. We think Redwood's low-latency inference story and dedicated/private options will resonate for joint accounts.

High level ask: one 45-minute joint demo + Q&A the week of Nov 15–19. Ops folks (marketplace packaging + entitlements) should be on the call.

Proposed hosts: Carolyn (Sandglass), Mark (Atlas), and a Redwood product lead — could you recommend someone?

I attached a short draft agenda.

Thanks,
Carolyn
Sandglass — Strategic Partnerships
Attachment: sandglass-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page PDF)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Carolyn Lee <carolyn@sandglass.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — Sandglass x Redwood joint marketplace showcase (Azure + GCP)

Hi Carolyn — great to meet you over email. Welcome, Mark.

Thanks for the agenda — looks doable. Vanessa (partner ops) and Vivek (platform eng) are cc'd to scope the technical runbook and entitlement ask. My availability for week of Nov 15 is: Nov 16 (10:00–12:00 PT) and Nov 18 (13:00–16:00 PT). If you need host coverage for both cloud tracks we should lock two time chunks so Atlas can run the GCP marketplace bit and Sandglass can run the Azure section.

One quick ops ask: can you confirm whether this will be a marketplace listing walkthrough (procurement flow + entitlement mapping) or a tech demo with a packaging checklist? We'll surface the right people depending on that.

I can host the Redwood product portion — I'll own the demo script and customer-facing slides.

Best,
Grace
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — Sandglass x Redwood joint marketplace showcase (Azure + GCP)

Grace — quick ops note. If this includes marketplace packaging we need a short pre-call with Atlas marketplace lead to confirm SKU/entitlement mapping and whether they want an integrated license flow demo. Can we do a 30-min preflight with Mark the week prior (Nov 9–12)? I'm available Nov 10 08:30–09:00 PT and Nov 11 11:00–11:30 PT.

Also propose we record the runbook in Drive and share the run-through checklist before the demo — I'll drop the latest runbook version (runbook_ops_v2.docx) in the shared folder. Vivek, can you confirm if we want a short live traffic demo vs. just slides (I recommend a short 5–7 minute live inference run to show latency on both Azure + GCP).

—Vanessa
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Mark Tran <mark@atlas-sys.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carolyn Lee <carolyn@sandglass.com>, Azure Marketplace Partner Team <marketplace-ops@partner.microsoft.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — Sandglass x Redwood joint marketplace showcase (Azure + GCP)

Thanks Vanessa — Nov 10 at 08:30 PT works for me for a quick preflight (I can do 08:30–09:00). The core agenda for the demo will be: 1) brief partner intros, 2) Azure marketplace packaging + SKUs, 3) GCP listing flow, 4) Redwood runtime demo (live calls), 5) Q&A and next steps.

Carolyn will send an updated agenda (tiny change to timing). We'll plan for the main joint demo on Nov 17 10:00–10:45 PT unless that collides with Redwood commitments — that slot keeps both US and EMEA partners reasonably happy.

Mark
Senior SI Lead, Atlas Systems
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Intro — Sandglass x Redwood joint marketplace showcase (Azure + GCP)

All — locking in Nov 10 08:30 PT preflight and Nov 17 10:00–10:45 PT for the public demo.

Action items:
- Vanessa: share runbook_ops_v2.docx in the Drive link and confirm recording permissions (Azure marketplace folks requested recording).
- Vivek: plan for a 5-minute live inference run across Azure (eastus) and GCP (us-central1) — keep payloads small, two concurrent requests. Note: we will be on dedicated capacity for the demo environment to avoid cold-start noise.
- Karthik: you and I will own the customer slide deck and the step-by-step marketplace entitlements page for the demo.
- Carolyn / Mark: thanks — please share final attendee list and any procurement/legal notes (if they want a follow-on procurement walkthrough we'll schedule a separate session).

I'll drop the Drive links and calendar invites after this thread.

Thanks team — concise and actionable.
Grace
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
